# Novarlo

> > Industrial safety equipment supplier specializing in arc flash protection, respiratory systems, and protective workwear from brands like National Safety Apparel, RPB, Majestic, and Moldex.

Novarlo provides NFPA 70E and OSHA-compliant safety solutions including CAT 4 arc flash gear, RPB respiratory systems (Nova 3, Nova 2000), cut-resistant gloves, and replacement parts for industrial safety equipment. Products are designed for electrical workers, abrasive blasting, and hazardous work environments.

## Key Topics

- Arc Flash Protection (40 cal CAT 4)
- NFPA 70E & CSA Z462 Compliance
- RPB Respiratory Systems
- Nova 3 & Nova 2000 Respirators
- National Safety Apparel ArcGuard RevoLite
- Fire Resistant (FR) Clothing
- Cut Resistant Gloves (ANSI Rated)
- Respiratory Replacement Parts
- Abrasive Blasting Equipment
- Chemical Resistant Gloves
- OSHA 1910.269 Compliance
- Majestic Work Gloves
- Moldex Respiratory Protection
- Faceshields & Safety Lenses
- High Visibility Safety Apparel
